instructions.name: init_treasury_yield
docs: Open the treasury's lending ledger (authority, once).

instructions.name: treasury_lend
docs: Lend part of the treasury. Spends the withdrawal allowance exactly like `admin_withdraw`,
and is refused while the treasury is frozen.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match `global_clp.authority`; owns `lend_account`.

accounts.name: lend_account
docs: The authority's own cUSDC account, which deposits into or withdraws from the
venue in the same transaction.

instructions.name: treasury_recall
docs: Bring lent treasury money back: `principal` of `amount` repays `venue`, the rest is interest.
Restores the allowance the returned principal spent, up to the burst. Allowed while frozen.

errors.name: WithdrawalLocked
errors.msg: Withdrawal locked for 7 days after deposit

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: Order expired — use cancel_swap to refund

errors.name: OrderNotExpired
errors.msg: Order not yet expired — wait for settlement or the TTL

errors.name: NoFreshOraclePush
errors.msg: No oracle push strictly newer than the commit yet

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidFunds
errors.msg: Insufficient liquid funds in vault. Wait for keeper to rebalance or perform forced DEX liquidation.

errors.name: HardBoundBreach
errors.msg: Hard inventory bound breached - operations restricted

errors.name: ExceedsMaxDeployment
errors.msg: Deployment exceeds maximum allowed for current risk state

errors.name: MaxDeploymentsExceeded
errors.msg: Maximum number of yield deployments reached

errors.name: OracleReadError
errors.msg: Could not read oracle account data

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: Pool address does not match configured Meteora pool

errors.name: PoolNotConfigured
errors.msg: Meteora pool not configured — run configure_meteora_pools first

errors.name: AdminWithdrawCapExceeded
errors.msg: Admin withdrawal would exceed the 24h cap of $100K — wait for window to roll or rotate authority if attack is suspected

errors.name: InvalidPosition
errors.msg: Position address does not match stored Meteora position

errors.name: InvalidAccountData
errors.msg: Account data too small for operation

errors.name: InvalidVault
errors.msg: Token account is not the expected protocol-owned vault

errors.name: TreasuryAllowanceExceeded
errors.msg: Withdrawal exceeds the accrued treasury allowance

errors.name: InvalidTreasuryParams
errors.msg: Invalid treasury limits: rate and burst must be > 0, delay within 0..=30 days, guardian set

errors.name: InvalidTreasuryDestination
errors.msg: Treasury destination must be the named token account and hold the global vault's mint

errors.name: TreasuryChangeNotReady
errors.msg: The pending treasury change is still inside its delay

errors.name: MarketMismatch
errors.msg: Market is not this CLP's market

errors.name: PoolClosedWhileLive
errors.msg: The book trades only while the market is closed; use a committed order

types.name: TreasuryLendParams
docs: Args for `treasury_lend` (one struct: the v1.45 multi-arg landmine).

fields.name: venue
docs: `YieldProtocol` discriminant: 0 Kamino, 1 MarginFi, 2 Other, 3 Solend, 4 JupiterLend.

types.name: TreasuryRecallParams
docs: Args for `treasury_recall`.

fields.name: amount
docs: cUSDC returned to the treasury vault.

fields.name: principal
docs: The part of `amount` that repays principal at `venue`; the rest is interest.

types.name: TreasuryYield
docs: The treasury's lending ledger, seeds `[b"treasury_yield"]`.

fields.name: by_venue
docs: Principal out at each venue: Kamino, MarginFi, Other, Solend, JupiterLend.

fields.name: principal
docs: Sum of `by_venue`.

fields.name: interest
docs: Interest returned to the treasury, all time.
